The partnership combines their complementary strengths to unlock a large, underserved market opportunity and expand the total addressable market (TAM) for both organisations. By bringing together Tata Communications’ cloud, AI and communications capabilities with TTSL’s extensive reach into the SMB sector, the companies are creating an integrated platform. This platform makes advanced AI solutions simpler, more accessible and easier to deploy for businesses without the complexity, cost or technical barriers typically associated with enterprise-grade technology. These AI agents can manage customer interactions, handle routine enquiries, schedule appointments and follow ups, process orders and provide personalised and always-on support at scale. For example, a pharmacy chain can offer every household a dedicated AI assistant for medicine refills and order management. Healthcare providers can automate appointment bookings and patient follow-ups. Manufacturers can provide personalised service support to thousands of customers simultaneously, significantly improving responsiveness while reducing operational overheads. The solution is powered by Commotion, Tata Communications’ conversational AI platform and hosted on Vayu AI Cloud, providing scalable and robust AI capabilities. The underlying voice infrastructure, ensuring high-quality, secure connectivity is powered by TTL. These AI agents securely access the data they require through a unified network fabric jointly developed by Tata Communications and TTL, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient data connectivity. The collaboration reflects a broader ambition to democratise access to advanced digital infrastructure for India’s growth engine of more than 60 million SMBs. This integrated approach not only simplifies adoption but also enables flexible consumption models – from ready-to-use AI agents to full-stack infrastructure access – depending on customer needs. Commenting on the partnership, Ganesh Lakshminarayanan, MD & CEO, Tata Communications, said: “India’s AI opportunity will be realised not only through large enterprises, but by empowering millions of SMBs with access to world-class digital infrastructure and intelligence capabilities. By combining TTSL’s extensive SMB relationships with our cloud, AI and communications expertise, we are creating a differentiated platform that allows businesses to adopt AI with confidence, while ensuring data sovereignty, security and scalability. This is also a powerful example of how Tata Group companies can come together to expand access, create new value for customers and unlock future growth opportunities.” “India’s SMB sector represents one of the world’s largest untapped opportunities for AI-led transformation,” added Harjit Singh, MD of Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited and Tata Teleservices Limited (together TTL). "What we have built together is a sovereign AI ecosystem that businesses can consume in the way that best suits them. Customers can adopt ready-to-use AI workers, bring their own AI applications onto our infrastructure, or directly leverage underlying AI cloud and development capabilities. The objective is simple – make AI practical, accessible and scalable for every business." The partnership creates a complementary go-to-market model spanning India’s SMB ecosystem through to large enterprises and global customers. While TTSL will continue to focus on SMBs, acting as the primary channel to bring AI-led solutions to this segment, Tata Communications will maintain its focus on global enterprises and communication service providers. Together, this approach not only extends the access to AI and digital infrastructure across previously underserved customer segments, but it also expands the combined TAM by enabling deeper market penetration and unlocking new revenue streams. As AI adoption becomes a key differentiator, Tata Communications and TTSL are delivering a simplified, scalable and sovereign pathway for SMBs to participate in the digital economy by combining infrastructure, innovation, and distribution strength into a single, unified offering. The companies expect the collaboration to evolve beyond voice AI, creating a foundation for a broader portfolio of AI-powered solutions and digital services for businesses in India and, over time, global SMB markets. Objective: Go Colors, "Comfort" Campaign Influencer Marketing Brief for WLDD From: Team Wirality (for Go Colors) Live window: 8 July to 15 August 2026 Status: Draft for WLDD Campaign theme: Life Moves In Your Comfort Zone Go Colors is known for leggings but now offers one of the widest bottom-wear ranges in the country. This campaign repositions it from a leggings-first brand to India's go-to bottom-wear destination, and redefines comfort as more than a product feature. The thought: comfort is what gives us the confidence to be ourselves and move through life with ease. The brand film follows a Tier A Bollywood celebrity in a world shaped by image and expectation, where she is being pushed into an idealised version of herself. As the pressure to conform grows, she breaks free into a more vibrant, expressive world where she can simply be herself, transforming the people and spaces around her from rigid and performative to relaxed and authentic, and moving through multiple Go Colors looks along the way. Because comfort is not where life slows down. It is where life moves. The idea, in one line An unbranded, staged style "controversy" that the internet decodes on its own, resolving into the comfort message and the film reveal. The power is in the slow reveal. The audience should feel like they discovered it. Platforms, in order of importance 1. Instagram (lead platform for the teaser, the live, the reveal and the sustain phase) 2. Twitter (X) (secondary, for real-time conversation, memes and PR pickup) Timeline 1: Teaser to film (8 to 16 July 2026) Date Day Beat Influencer role 8 Jul Wed Digital fake OOH drops. A Tier A Bollywood celebrity's gown “leaks” and reads as a style misfire, and fashion pages start reacting. Female comedians post a preview of the IG Live. Seed the faux pas. Fashion pages and comedians tease. 9 Jul Thu Female comedians go live on the faux pas. The celebrity joins the live and drops a comment. Amplification Blast 1 follows. Hero moment (comedian live). Amplifiers recount the live for those who missed it. 10 Jul Fri PR and memers comment the same day. Amplification Blast 2, the “Comfort is calling” post. Amplifiers speculate about what the live really meant. 11 Jul Sat “Diss Comfort Kal Aana” goes live in stores and on social, with a graffiti activation in regional languages. Let the internet connect the dots. Amplifiers push people to connect the dots. 12 Jul Sun The celebrity promotional teaser drops on the brand page. Amplification pages push it. Teaser push. 13 Jul Mon PR drops. Rest. 14 Jul Tue Further PR and meme coverage. Meme pages sustain the conversation. 15 Jul Wed Brand film goes live across all platforms. Full film amplification. 16 Jul Thu Marketing press coverage. Rest. Timeline 2: Sustain phase (16 July to 15 August 2026) After the film, we keep influencers active through a second phase. It runs on a set of content concepts we have already developed and shared alongside this brief (Comfort Confessions, Fashion's Red Flags, Killing Discomfort in My Wardrobe, and The Comfort Stress Test). We are not asking WLDD to invent the ideas, we need the right creators to bring them to life. The types we need: • Relatable lifestyle and everyday creators, for the confession and wardrobe-led ideas that invite audience participation. • Fashion and styling voices with an opinionated, witty tone, for the red-flags idea. • Honest, authentic storytellers comfortable being candid on camera, for the wardrobe clear-out. • Tech, fitness and data-curious creators whose audiences enjoy challenges and duets, for the Comfort Stress Test. Where influencers sit, and how many These numbers are for the launch push (Timeline 1). Sustain-phase creators are the types listed under Timeline 2. Content guardrails All meme and creator content must be brand-safe. No crass, vulgar or offensive memes, and nothing that mocks the influencers, the meme pages or the celebrity. Big Boy Toyz Setting the Stage to Become India’s Biggest Luxury Auction House Big Boy Toyz (BBT) has taken a decisive step towards redefining India’s luxury collectibles ecosystem with the launch of the BBT Auction App. An all-in-one digital platform designed to seamlessly connect buyers and sellers of the country’s most exclusive, high-value assets. From celebrity-owned luxury cars to elite number plates, exotic watches and VIP mobile numbers, the app is engineered to bring trust, transparency and global auction-house standards to the Indian market. The platform’s arrival was marked by a landmark moment in Indian auction history: the successful sale of the VIP number plate DDC 0001 for an extraordinary ₹2.08 crore, making it one of the most expensive car number plates ever auctioned in the country. The winning bidder is Kiran Kolipakula, a high-net-worth individual from Guntur, Andhra Pradesh. This underscores a growing trend of discreet luxury consumption and investment beyond traditional metro cities. This single transaction highlighted both the pan-India reach of the BBT Auction App and the increasing appetite for collectible assets with cultural and status value. At its core, BBT Auction is built to support both buyers and sellers of high-end collectibles. Sellers gain access to a curated, verified audience, while buyers benefit from detailed documentation, authentication and end-to-end transaction support. Every listing on the platform is backed by BBT’s rigorous verification standards, including ownership proof, service history checks and comprehensive photo and video documentation. Among the most compelling listings are celebrity-owned luxury vehicles, including Dinesh Karthik’s Range Rover Sport SVR, his Mercedes-Benz EQC 400, Shilpa Shetty’s Mercedes-Maybach GLS600 and Rohit Shetty’s Mercedes-Benz CLA 200D. These vehicles offer more than performance and luxury; they carry provenance, personal history and aspirational value that resonates deeply with collectors and enthusiasts. Beyond automobiles, the platform features some of India’s most exclusive number plates, VIP mobile numbers with rare repeating patterns and high-end timepieces such as the Hublot King Gold Skeleton Chronograph. Together, these assets reflect a broader shift in how luxury is perceived; not merely as ownership, but as a form of investment. With ambitions to become India’s equivalent of Sotheby’s or Christie’s, Big Boy Toyz envisions expanding the auction ecosystem further. In the future, the platform plans to include categories such as luxury handbags, rare collectibles and even premium real estate. For now, BBT Auction stands as a trusted, aspirational destination.
